# IDorganics

> IDorganics is a bulk supplier and manufacturer of certified organic food products, specializing in nuts, seeds, coffee, and breakfast items across European markets.

IDorganics operates as a wholesale distributor of organic products with strong emphasis on fair-trade sourcing and quality certification. The company serves B2B customers through both Dutch and English language platforms, with headquarters in the Netherlands and sourcing from regions including Colombia and other European suppliers.

## Key Topics

- Organic products
- Bulk wholesale
- BioNut brand
- Fair-trade certification
- Organic nuts
- Organic coffee
- Arabica beans
- Café Femenino
